paper_title: Constraining the photon coupling of ultra-light dark-matter axion-like particles by polarization variations of parsec-scale jets in active galaxies
notes: Paper sets new 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma for ULDM ALPs from non-observation of common-period EVPA oscillations in MOJAVE VLBA jets: <~1e-12 GeV^-1 for 5e-23 eV < m < 1.2e-21 eV (Fig. 6). No numerical table is given; data_points are reconstructed from the abstract statement, the Fig. 6 axis range (3e-13 to 1e-11 GeV^-1), and the theoretical scaling g_limit ~ m (Eq. 2.2 gives phi ~ g/m with roughly flat amplitude limits ~2-6 deg from Fig. 5), so values are approximate (factor ~2 uncertainty). The limit assumes DM density at the AGN host of 20 GeV/cm^3 (kappa=1); limits scale as kappa^(1/2). This is a source-side astrophysical DM density, not the local Milky Way halo density, so dm_density_assumed is left null. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
